phases.name: Phase 1: CLI agents module + wiring
phases.objective: Ship src/cli/agents.rs as a flat-file install clone of cli/skills.rs with BUNDLED_AGENTS registry, registered in mod.rs, dynamic.rs, and main.rs.
tasks: Task 1.1: Create src/cli/agents.rs cloning cli/skills.rs with BUNDLED_AGENTS (5 entries, include_str!)
Task 1.2: Add pub mod agents to src/cli/mod.rs
Task 1.3: Register agents subcommand in src/cli/dynamic.rs build_root parallel to skills
Task 1.4: Dispatch agents matches in src/main.rs parallel to skills block
acceptance_criteria: AC1.1: cargo build succeeds with the new include_str! paths
AC1.2: stores agents list prints exactly 5 entries with installed/uninstalled annotations
AC1.3: cargo test cli::agents passes; BUNDLED_AGENTS.len() == 5 asserted
AC1.4: stores agents install --all writes 5 flat .md files to .claude/agents/

decision_matrix.decision: Agent file layout: flat vs nested
decision_matrix.rationale: Claude Code's subagent loader scans flat <base>/<name>.md files; nesting would prevent registry registration. The asymmetry with skills' nested layout is intentional and platform-driven.
